title: Darren Oorloff, Pleasure Planet “Pure Romance” artwork
lede: A square artwork of chrome mannequin heads in a warped checkerboard room, with a pink gradient sphere, warped stripes, and a vertical title strip.
summary: Chrome heads, warped checkerboards, a red-pink sphere, and wavy stripes. Darren Oorloff, featured on @acidgraphix.

source.label: AIGA Eye on Design (5 September 2019): “Acid Graphics” Are the New Psychedelia

evidence.note: Inspected the 1200 px image `Darren-Oorloff-PP-Pure-Romance.jpg` that [Eye on Design](https://eyeondesign.aiga.org/acid-graphics-are-the-new-psychedelia-with-a-heady-dose-of-cynicism/) published with the article, in a scratch folder. Not stored. The object is a digital image as the magazine published it, not a named physical copy. The caption reads “Darren Oorloff, PP, Pure-Romance, as featured on @acidgraphix”. The square format suggests a record cover, but the source does not say so.

styles.note: Partial fit: chrome heads, warped op-art checkerboards, and glitch cuts as the article describes, but with pink and red, not acid green, and no chrome lettering.

context: [Eye on Design](https://eyeondesign.aiga.org/acid-graphics-are-the-new-psychedelia-with-a-heady-dose-of-cynicism/) shows the work in its 2019 article on acid graphics, with the caption “Darren Oorloff, PP, Pure-Romance, as featured on @acidgraphix”.
observed: Black-and-white checkerboards cover the floor and walls of a room and bend in perspective.
Two bald mannequin heads in profile face each other. Their surfaces are rendered as dark, reflective metal.
A red-to-violet gradient sphere sits on the checkerboard floor, and a red-pink doorway glows in the back wall.
A strip at the left holds “PLEASURE PLANET” in condensed capitals running vertically, “PURE ROMANCE” in italic capitals, the kanji 愛, and a panel of wavy red stripes.
Diagonal glitch cuts split the image near the left edge.
interpretation: The work shows the op-art and chrome-figure side of the trend that Eye on Design lists, with a pink palette that brings it close to vaporwave. It is a boundary case for this record.
borrow: Bend a checkerboard into a room to give a flat layout depth.
Run the title vertically in a narrow strip beside the image.

rights.statement: No image is stored. The work is recent and in copyright. The rights holder is the designer or the client.
